🏡 Petak Umpet: Village Edition brings Indonesia’s traditional hide-and-seek game to life! Explore villages inspired by Indonesian culture, outsmart your opponents, and race to escape!

🌿 AS A HIDER
Find interactive hiding spots, throw pebbles to distract Seekers, and use your abilities to stay one step ahead. Work together to activate 5 signals and unlock the escape pole early—or survive until it opens in the final 30 seconds!

🕵️ AS A SEEKER
Search the village, check hiding spots, and follow suspicious sounds. In Normal mode, sabotage an activated signal to briefly reveal Hider locations. Stop everyone from escaping!

🦠 INFECTION MODE
Caught Hiders become Seekers! Join the hunt or survive as the village fills with pursuers.

🐔 Watch your step—running near chickens might give away your position!
✨ Enjoy emotes, spectating, and controls for PC and mobile. Taking a break? Turn on AFK to skip the next round!

games.name: [UPDATE] Conquest: Napoleonic Wars [Pre-Alpha]
games.desc:
Conquest: Napoleonic Wars is a real time strategy (RTS) game based on the Napoleonic era, inspired by Napoleon Total War and a successor to Conquest by captainwoodlegs. 

Keybinds
R = Rotate units
Z = Show units range
H = toggle march at same speed
X = ping
C = halt selected units
Q = select all the units
E = deselect all selected units
Left control = see all the units goals positions without having them selected
Left control and click on an unit = select units without deselect.
T + click = move units into a line automatically
Shift + click = move all the selected units in formation rather than all to the same place
Shift + click a unit = selecting all the units of the same type
Shift + press a number = select all units of the same type

MOBILE 
Double tap and hold = dragging to select multiple units at once

Use /private in your own private server to open or close the servers settings UI
Use /unstuck if ur character cant move
